proposedTarget: Move lowercase canonicalization into `LanguageTag`, e.g. via `S.decode(SchemaTransformation.toLowerCase())` before the brand/check, so `serializeTerm` can emit the already-normalized value. The v4 transformation API is verified in `.repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/SchemaTransformation.ts` and the local exemplar is `packages/foundation/modeling/schema/src/internal/email.ts:36-38`.
